basic_profile.bio: Wanderlust-driven philosopher with a penchant for literature and cultural exploration. Based in Portland, Oregon, I spend my days diving into classic novels and the evenings exploring the latest indie games. Dislikes include early mornings and the overuse of jargon. Often online during late-night hours, as I work as a freelance editor. Currently single, but enjoy meaningful connections with fellow intellectuals.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Possesses a degree in Comparative Literature from a liberal arts college. Gained a deep understanding of cultural narratives through a combination of formal education and extensive travel experiences. Self-taught in niche areas like game lore and astrology, particularly focused on Sagittarians.
